ModMetaData.name: Psilocap Inspiration Tweak
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
This is a small patch that changes the inspiration chance of Psilocap from 2% to 6%.
If [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2574315206]XML Extensions[/url] is used, there will be mod settings where you can adjust this to whatever you like.
